title: Snapping at the bone for the shadow
html_source: The Dog and Its Reflection is another one of Aesop’s Fables: In the story, a dog that is carrying a stolen bone looks down as it is crossing a stream and sees its own reflection in the water. Mistaking it for another dog carrying something better, it opens its mouth to bark and in doing so drops what it was carrying.
